events.title: Universal Logistics (ULH) Reports Q1 Loss, Misses Revenue Estimates
events.body: Universal Truckload (ULH) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -244.44% and -1.27%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
